intro: Worship at CDPC Puchong is centred on Jesus. We gather as diverse followers of Jesus to hear God's Word, respond to his grace and belong to one another.

pillars.title: Christ-centred worship
pillars.text: We gather together for Christ-centred worship — turning our attention to Jesus, the one who rescues and renews us.

pillars.title: Scripture-based preaching
pillars.text: We seek to centre ourselves on Christ, the Gospel and the Word through Scripture-based expository preaching.

pillars.title: Grace-enabled spirituality
pillars.text: Created for good but broken by evil, we believe God rescues us by his grace and renews us to be people of healing.

music.heading: Music and singing
music.text: The style of music and singing at CDPC Puchong is being confirmed. We would be glad to tell you more if you message us.

online.heading: Watching online
online.text: We are confirming whether Sunday worship is available as a livestream. Please message us for the latest.

children.heading: Children among us
children.text: Our Children's Library offers a great collection of English books with a Story Time session, catered for people from toddlers to adults.
